decisive_items: compression of the third portion of the duodenum between the superior mesenteric artery and the aorta at an acute angle
Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy was normal, with no intrinsic luminal lesions
response.rationale: The raw imaging span directly names compression of the third part of the duodenum between the SMA and aorta, the defining mechanism of superior mesenteric artery syndrome. The vomiting, postprandial pain, bloating, lean habitus, and gastric distension support an extrinsic proximal obstruction, while normal endoscopy excludes an intrinsic luminal cause. No competing candidate was supplied.
